page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of HDD storage. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Given the massive local HDD storage capacity combined with a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for storage-intensive workloads. The hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, cold data storage, and big data processing pipelines that require high-capacity local storage rather than high-speed solid-state drives.
